newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low Keng Huat eyes improved results in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Low Keng Huat eyes improved results in 1997.

text.p: Property firm Low Keng Huat (Singapore) Ltd (LKH) said on Monday it expected results for its 1997 business year to show continued improvement after seeing losses cut by 24 percent in the year to January 31.

Despite soft market conditions, particularly in the retail sector, LKH said in a statement with its annual results that it expected "a general improvement in the operating performance of the group in the current year".
Positive contributions were expected from the initial launch of the first phase of a 1,600 unit housing project in Shanghai and from its investment in a Singapore retail development.
Hotel investments in Australia were also expected to continue their satisfactory performance, the company said.
